comment: Shared style-shading test scene (reef plan, risk 2 and step 14). Rendered on Linux GL by tests/test_style_shading_invariant.py and on Metal by scripts/macos/style-metal-ci.sh with the same flags; captures must agree within max_channel_delta per channel. Realistic exercises S1 water absorption, anime S3 toon bands. ReefSettings Seed 7 makes the Random layout and the fish deterministic. The geom-* scenes (scripts/build-style-geometry-scene.py) keep only the reef shell and the three hero rocks: no sub-pixel silhouettes, so the strict gate tests the shading math alone. The flat-* scenes (scripts/build-style-flat-scene.py) are untextured: flat-coloured, dynamically lit planes and boxes under the same Camera, fog and S1/S3 fields.

sweep.comment: Existing-level sweep (step 14): every *-standalone.iff of the baseline tree, S fields at their defaults, frame 20; baseline and candidate engines must be pixel-identical. vram: [width, height, slot, perm height] for levels whose textures exceed the defaults.
